products.name: Freight Lane Margin Anomaly
products.product: Detects unusual lane, carrier, customer, and rep margin shifts before quotes or tenders repeat the loss.
products.audience: small freight brokers and managed transportation providers
products.problem: Aggregate margin reports arrive after bad buy rates, accessorials, and customer prices have already repeated.
products.valueProposition: Explains the source of each margin anomaly and directs pricing or carrier actions to the affected lane.
products.startupCost: Solo MVP: web app, CSV import, managed database, and optional read-only integrations.

products.seoThesis: A narrow site for small freight brokers and managed transportation providers can connect commercial pages, calculators, comparisons, and implementation guides around freight broker lane margin analytics to the same measurable margin outcome.
